title: Optimal driving strategies for a fleet of trains
summary: In order to manage electricity transmission and distribution it is now common practice for system operators to offer financial incentives that encourage large consumers to reduce energy usage during designated peak demand periods. For train operators on large rail networks it may be profitable -- with selected individual journeys -- to reduce energy usage during peak times and increase energy usage at other times rather than simply minimizing overall energy consumption.
